panel.name: plus_presets
panel.panel.string: Applying the graphics settings. The viewer stands still for a few seconds (up to about 20 seconds the first time a combination is used, while its shaders are prepared).

The Charis graphics presets are now part of the quality slider (Preferences > Graphics, the photo tools' Quality tab: seven levels from Low to Ultra). The preset you used is now the "[LEVEL]" level; your draw distance and avatar limits are as they were.
The Charis graphics presets are now part of the quality slider (Preferences > Graphics, the photo tools' Quality tab: seven levels from Low to Ultra). Your graphics settings are as they were.
